dct_title_s: Philippines Northern Cebu Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Oct 2025
dct_description_sm: # Philippines Northern Cebu Earthquakes: Damage Proxy Maps, Oct 2025 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Philippines Northern Cebu Earthquakes (Oct 2025) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Northern Cebu, Philippines, Earthquakes, 05 Oct 2025, v0.9 ** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Northern Cebu, Philippines, Earthquakes, 02 Oct 2025, v0.5 ** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** leaflet/EOS-RS_202510_Philippines_Northern_Cebu_Earthquakes **Legal Disclaimer:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025)
